cases.name: Amber Dawn Compton
cases.about: She was a a registered nurse with the Virginia Department of Corrections and worked at the Keen Mountain Correctional Facility in Oakwood, VA. Compton's mother Rachel described her daughter as a "wonderful, wonderful mother," News Channel 11 reports. "A wonderful daughter. Everything that she did always [was] done [for] the benefit of her children."
cases.narrative: On 10/22/2022, police found her deceased in her home while investigating a missing report.
